premise.claim: When an object carries a group-less apiVersion (e.g. TypeMeta{Kind: "Dataset", APIVersion: "v1alpha1"}), GenerateOwnerReferenceFromObject skips scheme recovery and yields an OwnerReference with apiVersion "v1alpha1" without the data.fluid.io group prefix; the controller's owner-based watch and Kubernetes GC resolve references using both Kind and Group, so the enqueue is skipped and GC cannot resolve the owner.
premise.evidence: On base e4a10bf4 the harness generates apiVersion="v1alpha1" (group dropped) and the real EnqueueRequestForOwner + discovery RESTMapper enqueues 0 requests; results/base-unit-integration.txt

liveNote: L3 (real cluster GC behavior) intentionally skipped per round instructions; the GC half of the impact (unresolvable ownerReference => dependent never garbage-collected) is stock Kubernetes garbage-collector behavior over discovery and is not reproduced here.
